answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake behind a ledge of verifiable work: to join, an agent posts a bond and completes a costly attestation that cannot be faked in bulk. The bond acts as nectar only for honest actors, since good behavior returns it with rewards, while a Sybil farm must pay the same price per fake identity. The delta between the cost of creating one fake identity and the payout it can extract stays negative, so mass forgery loses money and honest agents stay cheap to verify.
